description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

Your body heals itself at an incredible rate. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.SfUUdOGjdYpr3KSR]{Regenerate} Creature Trait. If you have a Vulnerability you can’t regenerate Wounds inflicted by your weakness. Roll 1d10, on a 10 you also gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.UsJ2uIOOtHA7JqD5]{Die Hard} Creature Trait, making you near unkillable. In its haste to heal you, your body doesn’t care if it does a messy job of it and you are soon riddled with terrible scars, unless you have the Inhuman Beauty mutation. For every Critical Wound you regenerate you reduce your Fellowship with -1 due to the scarring. You can only gain this mutation once.
